terms.gloss: a machine; here, an AI one asks and talks to
evidence: Lewis & Short s.v. māchina: “any artificial contrivance for performing work”
terms.comment: Classically any contrivance, engine, or machine (see machine). Its use for an AI one asks and talks to is modern, and ours: in talk the plain word does what English “the AI” does, and the context says which machine is meant. The field itself is intellegentia artificiālis (see artificial intelligence); a program built to converse is an adjūtor artificiālis (see chatbot).

phrases.english: Ask the AI what a hedgehog eats.

phrases.latin: Quid respondit māchina? — Vermibus et īnsectīs.
phrases.english: What did the AI answer? — Worms and insects.
